claim: All Amazon Managed Grafana user licenses are per workspace, per month; a Viewer license costs $5 per active user per workspace and gives view-only access.

evidence.quote: All user licenses are per workspace, per month.

For customers who need only view access, an Amazon Managed Grafana Viewer license costs $5 per active user per workspace and provides the user with view-only access to the Amazon Managed Grafana workspace.
